content: Apple’s iPhone and Mac sales are on the rise even as a global memory shortage squeezes device makers. In its third-quarter earnings report released on Thursday, Apple revealed that iPhone sales jumped 22 percent to $54.25 billion and Mac sales increased 29 percent to $10.35 billion, driving the company’s overall revenue to $109.4 billion. The company expects supply chain constraints to worsen in the coming months. During an earnings call, Apple chief financial officer Kevan Parekh said Apple expects “supply constraints to increase significantly” in the next quarter, adding the shortage will impact the iPhone, Mac, and iPad. Meanwhile, Apple CEO Tim Cook warned that the company predicts it will “pay even higher memory costs” in the coming months. It’s the company’s last earnings report with Cook at the helm. Cook is set to step down on September 1st, with John Ternus, Apple’s vice president of hardware engineering, taking his place. Apple raised prices across its Macs, iPads, and other devices in June as it contends with a RAM shortage expected to last until 2027 and beyond. The move also included a price hike for the company’s new MacBook Neo, which now costs $699 instead of $599. Since its debut in March, the Neo disrupted the affordable laptop market with its lightweight form factor and speedy performance. Apple hasn’t raised the prices of its iPhones yet, but analysts predict that the iPhone 18 could cost up to $200 more when the lineup launches this fall. Apple is planning to widely release its more personalized Siri AI alongside the iPhone 18, allowing its assistant to answer questions about what’s on your screen, search across apps, and perform tasks, like adding events to your calendar.  This week, Apple also announced a new Upgrade program that will let you lease an iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, or Mac for a set monthly price. Additionally, Apple reported $30.74 billion in services revenue, which incorporates subscriptions like Apple One and Apple TV. Parekh added during the earnings call that the company now has more than 1.5 billion subscribers across its services. Apple also reported $7.88 billion in revenue for wearables and a lower-than-expected $6.2 billion in iPad revenue.

chineseContent: 尽管全球内存短缺给设备制造商带来了压力，但苹果的 iPhone 和 Mac 销量仍在增长。苹果在周四发布的第三季度财报中透露，iPhone 销量增长 22% 至 542.5 亿美元，Mac 销量增长 29% 至 103.5 亿美元，带动公司整体收入达到 1094 亿美元。该公司预计未来几个月供应链限制将进一步恶化。苹果首席财务官 Kevan Parekh 在财报电话会议上表示，苹果预计下一季度“供应限制将大幅增加”，并补充说短缺将影响 iPhone、Mac 和 iPad。与此同时，苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克警告称，该公司预计未来几个月将“支付更高的内存成本”。这是库克执掌该公司的最后一份收益报告。库克将于 9 月 1 日卸任，苹果硬件工程副总裁约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 接替他的位置。苹果在 6 月份提高了 Mac、iPad 和其他设备的价格，因为该公司面临预计将持续到 2027 年及以后的 RAM 短缺问题。此举还包括该公司新款 MacBook Neo 的价格上涨，现在的价格为 699 美元，而不是 599 美元。自 3 月份推出以来，Neo 以其轻巧的外形和快速的性能颠覆了平价笔记本电脑市场。苹果尚未提高 iPhone 的价格，但分析师预测，当该系列产品于今年秋季推出时，iPhone 18 的价格可能会上涨 200 美元。苹果计划与 iPhone 18 一起广泛发布更个性化的 Siri AI，允许其助手回答有关屏幕上内容的问题、跨应用程序搜索以及执行任务，例如将事件添加到日历中。  本周，苹果还宣布了一项新的升级计划，让您
